blocks.html:
Golf Cart Wrap

Vinyl Wrap Toronto does not just do commercial wraps, we can wrap almost anything vinyl sticks to. We wrapped another golf cart last summer for this client and he was extremely happy. The customer was so happy with the wrap, he brought us his other golf cart to fully wrap.

The design was based on the previous full golf cart wrap with the addition of green this time. The design was also used to wrap a boat that Vinyl Wrap Toronto will feature next week. Our design team worked with the previous design and the client to ensure that he was happy before anything was printed and applied. Because this is the second golf cart full wrap we have done, it was much easier to complete the job.

Our crew has many years of experience with wrapping all types of vehicles and equipment. The client delivered the recreational vehicle partially disassembled. This helps our installers to wrap the vehicle quicker. Reducing the cost to the customer.

The vinyl we used is the same as we use for cars and boats. Vinyl Wrap Toronto mainly uses Avery Dennison Printable vinyl for vehicle wraps. We then laminate the printed vinyl for added protection and help to ensure the vinyl lasts. The laminate also helps with the general wear and tear that a recreational vehicle like this will endure.

Speak to our installation team about your recreational or equipment wraps at 416-746-1381. Click here to view more recreational wraps that we did.
Or Visit our garage to see samples of the vinyl we use at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit #1, Etobicoke, M9W 1B4.

If you are looking for any HealthSafetyBoards or Covid-19 posters, Signs, or Floor Graphics, Visit HealthSafetyBoard.com
